basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 32.' and it opens 'Vers. 32. Seorsum Joseph, et seorsum fratribus. Quasi extraneis. Aegyptiis, quasi'. The printing's caput is stale here, its marker for this chapter being missing, so the chapter is taken from the lemma, whose best match anywhere in Genesis falls on the very verse the printing numbers.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 32. Seorsum Joseph, et seorsum fratribus. Quasi extraneis. Aegyptiis, quasi indigenis, seorsum.
